body:
Adds `research/multi-observation-elicitation`: multi-observation elicitation (Casalaina-Martin, Frongillo, Morgan, Waggoner) applied to the audit cost of pricing benign floating-point drift in verifiable training.

- Exact pair score for variance (excess loss `(r−σ²)²`), kernels for mean², third central moment, σ⁴ (2, 3, 4 draws), verified by exact enumeration
- Audit cost `((z_α+z_β)/ρ)²(κ+1)/2` pairs; Monte Carlo power 0.70–0.79 vs nominal 0.8
- Robust Gini score beats the variance score for heavy tails; all-pairs pooling saves `(κ+1)/(κ−1)`; correlated draws bias the target to `σ²(1−ρ)`
- 11 tests, portfolio page and README updated. Stylised distributions, no measured drift.
